claim: 天台得名于天台山（“天空的平台”）；SEP 以智顗（538—597）、湛然（711—782）、知礼（960—1028）为三位最具代表性人物。
locator: SEP Tiantai：'Tiantai is the name of a mountain and surrounding geographical location in China, literally meaning "platform of the sky"'；'the writings of its three most representative figures: Tiantai Zhiyi (538–597), Jingxi Zhanran (711–782) and Siming Zhili (960–1028)'
note: 本包为独立重抓全文并多轮 grep 提取（非复用 T01 片段）。

claim: 天台为6世纪中国成型的大乘宗派，以《法华经》一佛乘与方便为宗旨；Ziporyn 称其为“对印度佛教传统最早的彻底中国化改造”。
locator: Wikipedia Tiantai Buddhism：'an East Asian Buddhist school of Mahāyāna Buddhism that developed in 6th-century China'；'Tiantai Buddhism emphasizes the "One Vehicle" (Ekayāna) doctrine derived from the influential Lotus Sūtra'；Ziporyn 引文 'the earliest attempt at a thoroughgoing Sinitic reworking of the Indian Buddhist tradition'

claim: 世系：龙树传统初祖；慧文（6世纪）依龙树书有悟传慧思（515—577），慧思传智顗；世系为后人拟议。
locator: S4：'Nāgārjuna, who is traditionally regarded as the first patriarch of the school'；'The sixth century dhyāna master Huiwen (慧文) is traditionally considered to be the second patriarch... Through studying and meditating on the works of Nāgārjuna'；'Huiwen later transmitted his teachings to Chan master Nanyue Huisi (南嶽慧思, 515-577)'；'Huisi then transmitted his teachings to Zhiyi (智顗, 538-597)'；'The above lineage was proposed by Buddhists of later times and do not reflect the popularity of the monks at that time.'；S5：'北齊慧文：禪師。依從龍樹《大智度論》修行禪法。'
note: 世数各谱不一：S4 以慧文为第二代，S5 称慧思为二祖——已入 evidenceLimits。
uncertainty: 世系系传统拟议，不作教团史实。

claim: SEP 总纲：天台最根本的改造是从二谛到三谛；三谛定义（空/假/中）与但中、不但中之分。
locator: SEP：'The heart of the matter, the most fundamental and far-reaching renovation of Buddhism accomplished by the Tiantai School, is the move from the Two Truths model to a Three Truths one.'；'Thus the Three Truths are: Provisional Positing: Some X is always appearing. Emptiness: X is not (only) X.'；'this is the Center in its simplest formulation, as "the exclusive Center" (但中 danzhong)'；'the "Non-exclusive Center" (不但中 budan zhong)'

claim: 一心三观与一念三千在《摩訶止觀》卷五有逐字原文：三观归结于中论；一念三千段全句可考。
locator: 维基文库《摩訶止觀》卷005：'若一法一切法。即是因緣所生法。是為假名假觀也若一切法即一法。我說即是空空觀也。若非一非一切者即是中道觀。'（页面上“也”“若”间无句号，本包引文按句补断）；'一空一切空無假中而不空。總空觀也。一假一切假無空中而不假。總假觀也。一中一切中無空假而不中。總中觀也。即中論所說不可思議一心三觀。'；'夫一心具十法界。一法界又具十法界百法界。一界具三十種世間。百法界即具三千種世間。此三千在一念心。若無心而已。介爾有心即具三千。'
note: SEP 所引同段作「若無心而己」（己/已一字异文），本包从维基文库（大正藏底本），异文已入 evidenceLimits。
uncertainty: 未做 CBETA 第二藏经对勘（在线版正文 JS 渲染无法抓取）。

claim: 五时八教判教：五时年限与化法/化仪四教；SEP 称化法四教为哲学上最重要者；学术按语：成熟体系出湛然，智顗未一次给全。
locator: S4：'its classification of the Buddha's teachings (called a panjiao) into the "Five Periods and Eight Teachings" (五時八教)'；'The Avatamsaka Period (華嚴時): For twenty-one days...'；'the mature system was developed by Zhanran and that Zhiyi never presents a single system of "Five Periods and Eight Teachings"'；S1：'the most philosophically important is the classification of the four types of contents of the Buddha's teaching (化法四教), called the Four Teachings, namely, Tripitaka, Shared, Separate, and Perfect'
note: 判教为解释框架而非编年，timeline 不设五时节点。

claim: 性具善恶与无情有性：智顗破地论/摄论两偏而主十界善恶具足；湛然《金刚錍》以虚空喻发展无情有性。
locator: S1：'the famous Tiantai claim that "evil is inherently included in Buddhahood"'；'The controversial idea of "the Buddha-nature of insentient beings" is developed by Zhanran in his Jingangpi using a slightly different approach to the Three Truths, focusing on the trope of space'；S4：'he argued that the ultimate reality includes all the good and evil of all ten realms. This idea was further defended and developed by later Tiantai figures like Jingxi Zhanran'
note: 性恶原典出处句（观音玄义系）未逐字核读，不引原句。 审计注记 2026-10-04：SEP 原页拼作 'Buddhahod'（SEP 自身笔误），本包按义转写 'Buddhahood'，非原文照录。

claim: 止观体系：《摩訶止觀》（T1911）为主要禅观指南，四种三昧、圆顿止观；灌顶整理三大部。
locator: S4：'The Mohe Zhiguan (摩訶止觀; "The Great Calming and Contemplation") (T1911), the main meditation guide of the tradition'；'the "four samādhis"'；'the "perfect and sudden" method'；'his disciple Guanding, who compiled the masters' "three main works" after Zhiyi's death'；S5：'章安灌頂（561年－632年）……他整理出天台三大部'

claim: 宋代山家/山外与东传：知礼护山家成正统；最澄从道邃学开日本 Tendai；12世纪高丽 Cheontae。
locator: S4：'culminated in a famous debate known as the "home mountain" (shanjia) vs. "off mountain" (shanwai) debate'；"Zhili's 'Home mountain' view turned out to be the most influential, and his works became part of the orthodox Tiantai canon during the Song dynasty"；'Daosui is important because he was the primary teacher of Saichō, the founder of the Japanese Tiantai tradition (known in Japanese as Tendai)'；'A Korean branch, the Cheontae school, was also established during the 12th century'

claim: 龙树：被传统尊为天台初祖，《中论》《大智度论》为宗内重要文本与慧文禅法所依。
locator: S4：'Nāgārjuna, who is traditionally regarded as the first patriarch of the school'；'Madhyamaka works associated with Nāgārjuna like the Chung lun (Madhyamakaśāstra; Taishō 1564) and the Dà zhìdù lùn (T. no. 1509) are important sources for the Tiantai school'；S5：'北齊慧文：禪師。依從龍樹《大智度論》修行禪法'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 有龙树（约150—250年），纪年从站内。

claim: 智顗：三谛、一念三千、化法四教与性具的建立者；《摩訶止觀》为其禅观定著。
locator: S1：'Tiantai Zhiyi (538–597)'；'The locus classicus of the above enumeration is Zhiyi's definitive work on meditation, Mohezhiguan (摩訶止觀)'；S2 卷005 一念三千全句（见 overview 条）；S5：'天台智顗（538年－597年），天台宗（或称"法華宗"）的实际创始人'
note: 站内姓名'智顗'、纪年'538-597年'取自 philosophers.json，与 S1/S4/S5 一致。

claim: 慧思（515—577）：传法于智顗的世系中间环节，传证法华三昧。
locator: S4：'Huiwen later transmitted his teachings to Chan master Nanyue Huisi (南嶽慧思, 515-577), who is traditionally figured as the third patriarch'；'who is said to have practiced the Lotus Samādhi'（此句 S4 系于智顗段；慧思段为 'During meditation, he is said to have realized the "Lotus Samādhi"'）；S5：'南嶽慧思（515年－577年），天台宗二祖'
note: 站外人物；世数 S4（第三代）与 S5（二祖）不一，已声明。

claim: 灌顶（561—632）：智顗上首弟子，整理三大部成书。
locator: S4：'his disciple Guanding, who compiled the masters' "three main works" after Zhiyi's death'；S5：'章安灌頂（561年－632年），智顗大師之徒。他整理出天台三大部'
note: 站外人物。

claim: 湛然（711—782）：三大部三疏与《金刚錍》无情有性；SEP 列为三大代表之二。
locator: S1：'Jingxi Zhanran (711–782)'；'developed by Zhanran in his Jingangpi'；S4：'Zhanran's Adamantine Scalpel (a work on Buddha-nature)'；配套书目 'Zhiguan fuxing zhuan hongjue (止觀輔行傳弘決), (T1912)'、'Fahua Xuanyi Shiqian (法華玄義釋籤), (T1717)'、'Fahua Wenju Ji (法華文句記), (T1719)'；S5：'荊溪湛然（711年－782年），著有《止觀輔行傳弘決》、《法華玄義釋籤》、《法華文句疏記》等'
note: 站外人物；S5《法華文句疏記》与 S4《法華文句記》名目微异，packet 从 S4 大正藏编号名目。

claim: 知礼（960—1028）：宋代山家代表，注智顗书、护三谛正统；SEP 列为三大代表之三。
locator: S1：'Siming Zhili (960–1028)'；S4：'The most eminent figure during this period was Patriarch Siming Zhili (960–1028), who wrote various commentaries on Zhiyi's works and defended the so called "Home mountain" view'；'arguing instead that the "three truths" as taught by Zhiyi are the ultimate reality'；'mind or consciousness has no special status relative to other types of phenomena, such as physical matter'；S5：'四明知禮（960年－1028年）：從「螺溪傳教院」寶雲義通學習天台教觀，為山家派代表人物'
note: 站外人物。

claim: 仁岳（992—1064）：师事知礼十余年后转倡山外，为后山外派代表。
locator: S5：'淨覺仁岳 (992-1064) 曾師事四明知禮十餘年，後放棄山家派觀點，力倡山外，自成一派，為後山外派代表人物。'
note: 站外人物；仅 S5 一源载，故 thinkers 条目表述严格限于该句内容。

claim: 最澄：从湛然弟子道邃（Daosui）受学，日本 Tendai 创立者；日本天台9世纪自天台分出。
locator: S4："Zhanran's disciple and seventh patriarch Daosui (796–805)... Daosui is important because he was the primary teacher of Saichō, the founder of the Japanese Tiantai tradition (known in Japanese as Tendai)"；'The Japanese Tendai school is also an influential tradition which branched off from Tiantai during the 9th century'
note: 站外人物；具体生卒与入唐年份不采（Saichō 条目维护横幅问题，见 review.md）。
uncertainty: 生卒纪年仅给“9世纪初在世”。

claim: 龙树→智顗：二谛到三谛的改造；三谛由智顗读龙树中观（尤其二谛说）发展而来；传统尊龙树为初祖但世系系后人拟议。
locator: S1 'the move from the Two Truths model to a Three Truths one' 句；S4："The Threefold Truth... This view was developed by Zhiyi's reading of Nāgārjuna's Madhyamaka philosophy, especially its doctrine of two truths."；'The above lineage was proposed by Buddhists of later times'
note: type 标为接受/发展（传统尊奉＋文本所依），不写历史师承。

claim: 慧思→智顗：传统世系传法。

claim: 智顗→知礼：山家派对原典教义的守护——知礼注智顗书、以智顗三谛为终极实在、主心色平等。
